author: Azim Ahmadzadeh
scope: Public organizer self-evaluation reference, not a guarantee of private leaderboard edge-case checks. No external annotations downloaded or notebook executed.
aggregation: Pool all true-positive IoUs and false-positive/negative counts across every annotation set.
matching: All mask pairs with IoU strictly greater than 0.5; raw overlapping GT masks preserved for evaluation.
relations: Reference diagnostic links use any overlap; custom robust relations retained separately.
